item.title: JD(S) leader arrested for assaulting Bengaluru traffic constable on duty - video
item.summary: JD(S) leader Manjunath was arrested for allegedly assaulting a traffic constable on duty. The incident occurred when the constable stopped Manjath's vehicle to regulate traffic flow. An argument escalated, and Manjath reportedly grabbed the constable by his collar. A viral video shows Manjath speaking to a senior officer and attempting to kick the constable. Police registered a case and subsequently arrested Manjath for obstructing a public servant.
